understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the '+' goal gem to win the level by navigating horizontally and using gravity to fall through the level.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT change horizontal position, after which the character automatically falls in the current gravity direction until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. CLICK removes clickable breakable blocks at the specified coordinates and can open fall paths; it may also trigger gravity if the removed block was supporting or blocking the player. Spikes cause immediate failure, while support tiles are safe. UNDO reverts the previous action and should be preserved for recovering from mistakes.
